Carla (AE): Heads-up — ACME trial reporting they can't correlate traces with Redwood logs. They see requests in our console but Datadog queries for trace_id return nothing. Can SE + SRE swarm? :eyes:
Mike (SE): I'm on it. Do they have the `x-trace-id` header forwarded from their frontend? That’s usually the missing piece.
Anita (SRE): Quick check — are they using our ingest endpoint or going through a log drain? If drain, trace_id field might be renamed/stripped.
Carla (AE): They're on our hosted API via the trial account, not a drain. Customer says logs show `request_id` but no `trace_id`.
Mike (SE): Ok ask them for a raw log line and an example trace_id they tried querying. Also need the embed/stream request snippet so we can reproduce.
Jorge (Platform Eng): Also confirm they aren't sampling away traces in their tracer. If they're using OpenTelemetry, sampling default could be 0.1.
Carla (AE): Sent the sample log (pasted below).
Carla (AE): 2026-03-21T19:08:12.345Z INFO user=acme svc=inference request_id=aa12bb trace_id=
Mike (SE): That trace_id looks empty — maybe fluentd/agent is dropping the header. Ask for their Fluentd/FluentBit mapping.
Carla (AE): They posted their config, snippet: 
```
<filter kubernetes.**>
  @type record_transformer
  <record>
    trace_id ${record["trace_id"] || record["headers"]["x-trace-id"]}
  </record>
</filter>
```
Mike (SE): Two quick things — 1) `record["headers"]` may not exist depending on parser; use `record.fetch("headers", {})` or pre-parse. 2) If the header is `X-Amzn-Trace-Id` or similar, the key differs. Ask them to dump raw request headers from one call.
Anita (SRE): Also saw a 429 spike in their tenant this morning. If rate limiting is returning early responses, some middleware might be swallowing headers on the error path. Any logs showing `status=429`?
Carla (AE): Yes they reported intermittent 429s when load-testing. Example: `POST /v1/stream 429` but logs after that show no trace_id.
Mike (SE): For immediate triage: 1) reproduce with a `curl -v` that includes `X-Trace-Id: 0000-TEST-TRACE` and confirm it appears in our console. 2) If it doesn't, we check ingress proxy (nginx/ALB) header passthrough.
Mike (SE): Example curl to test:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "X-Trace-Id: 0000-TEST-TRACE" \  
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```
Jorge (Platform Eng): I'll check ingress logs and the header whitelist. If using ALB we need `preserve_host`/`x-forwarded-*` rules.
Anita (SRE): Also to avoid 429s during their POC, recommend turning on short-lived burst capacity (Dedicated) or reduce concurrency while we debug. For the trial, set client concurrency to 2 and add prefix caching — reduces token pressure.
Carla (AE): Customer also asked about trace retention pricing if they want 30d traces in the Console. Pricing team — any quick pointer? :money_with_wings:
Mike (SE): For now tell them retention add-on is billed monthly; I'll DM pricing doc. (private)
TelemetryBot: Exporter deployment status: project-acme -> datadog/hec configured, status: pending verification.
Mike (SE): If the `curl` shows `X-Trace-Id` coming through to our logs, then Datadog query should be `service:inference trace_id:0000-TEST-TRACE` or in APM you can search by trace id.
Carla (AE): Customer tried `trace_id:aa12bb` in Datadog and got zero hits.
Mike (SE): If header present but not in logs, instrument our runtime to print headers on debug. Temporary log line: `logger.debug("headers=", headers)` — only enable for their tenant.
Anita (SRE): I can flip debug for tenant `acme-trial` for 30 minutes. Will monitor for PII.
Carla (AE): They asked about security questionnaire items around logs and PII — specifically whether trace ids can be correlated to user emails. We need a short answer for them.
Jorge (Platform Eng): Short: trace_id is a request-level identifier and not a user identifier by default. PII should not be emitted into trace_id; we mask/strip headers that match email regexes in ingress. Send them our logging policy link: https://redwood.ai/docs/logging-policy (internal).
Carla (AE): Customer ok with that but wants confirmation in the SQ. I'll attach our policy excerpt.
Mike (SE): Plan of action: 1) Carla to collect raw `curl -v` header output. 2) Customer to run the test with `X-Trace-Id`. 3) Anita to enable debug for 30m. 4) Jorge to check ALB header passthrough. 5) I’ll validate Datadog query. If all good, we close loop and update runbook.
Carla (AE): I'll schedule a quick call tomorrow 10am PT and share the runbook link.
TelemetryBot: Exporter verification complete for project-acme — status: healthy. :white_check_mark:
Mike (SE): Great — once they confirm trace_id shows in our logs and in Datadog we'll mark the POC telemetry closed. Thanks everyone. :thanks:
